Manually checked helper loops, raise_to_z macro and final_exp transcription. Counts315 cyclotomic squares,35 dense products,10 conjugations, Frobenius2/3/2/1 and one inverse agree. This supports only equality-to-identity, not equality of general GT outputs. The easy exponent maps into the cyclotomic subgroup; replacing optimized squares by dense squares avoids assuming an implemented cyclotomic optimization.

Inputs to the dense routine must already have well-formed constrained limbs, and a fixed zero operand is used for subtraction-based negation.
